close_reason: Already fixed: resolver init failure now maps to DnsLookupFailed, not DnsTxtInvalid. DnsLookupFailed carries the error string and is semantically correct for network/system failures.
description: mta_sts_dns.rs:23 maps TokioResolver builder failure to MtaStsError::DnsTxtInvalid('resolver init failed: ...'). DnsTxtInvalid semantically means 'the remote domain published a malformed TXT record'. A local resolver init failure is a completely different condition. The error message distinguishes them, but the enum variant does not. Add a DnsTransient or ResolverInitFailed variant, or reuse a more appropriate variant.
title: DnsTxtInvalid wrong error variant for resolver init failure
